newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's long-term PHIBOR rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Manila's long-term PHIBOR rates unchanged.

text.p: The long-term Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were stuck at their previous levels as traders remained cautious ahead of Monday's auction.
"We're not sure how the auction will go on Monday, especially in longer maturing bills," one trader said.
The average one-year Treasury bill rate had fallen to the 10 percent range, close to the three-month average rate. Traders believed that the one-year rate might have hit its bottom.
The PHIBOR market will be closed on Thursday for the Philippine Independence day. It will reopen on Friday.
